VULN.TITLE: Apache Struts Remote Code Execution
VULN.SOLUTION: Upgrade Apache Struts to version 6.3.0.2 or later. Apply vendor security advisory S2-066.
VULN.DESCRIPTION: A critical path traversal vulnerability in Apache Struts allows remote code execution via file upload manipulation. Attackers can upload malicious files to any directory on the server.

VULN.TITLE: Oracle WebLogic Server IIOP RCE
VULN.SOLUTION: Apply Oracle Critical Patch Update January 2023. Restrict IIOP access via firewall rules.
VULN.DESCRIPTION: Oracle WebLogic Server is vulnerable to remote code execution via the IIOP/T3 protocol. Unauthenticated attackers can exploit this to run arbitrary commands with WebLogic server privileges.

VULN.TITLE: Java Deserialization via Apache Commons Collections
VULN.SOLUTION: Upgrade Apache Commons Collections to 3.2.2 or 4.1. Implement deserialization filters (JEP 290).
VULN.DESCRIPTION: Apache Commons Collections prior to 3.2.2 and 4.1 allows remote code execution via unsafe Java deserialization when user-controlled serialized data is deserialized.

VULN.TITLE: PostgreSQL Superuser Privilege Escalation
VULN.DESCRIPTION: PostgreSQL CREATE SCHEMA allows non-superuser roles to escalate privileges to superuser by injecting commands that execute as a superuser during schema creation.

VULN.TITLE: Unencrypted Database Connection Accepted
VULN.SOLUTION: Set ssl=on in postgresql.conf and enforce ssl in pg_hba.conf.
VULN.DESCRIPTION: The PostgreSQL server accepts unencrypted connections. This allows network-level attackers to intercept database credentials and data in transit via man-in-the-middle attacks.

VULN.TITLE: Stored XSS in User Profile Fields
VULN.SOLUTION: Sanitize all user-supplied input using context-aware output encoding. Implement Content Security Policy headers.
VULN.DESCRIPTION: The customer portal fails to sanitize user-supplied HTML in profile fields, allowing stored cross-site scripting. Attackers can inject persistent scripts that execute in the browsers of all users who view the affected profile.

VULN.TITLE: Missing HTTP Strict Transport Security Header
VULN.SOLUTION: Add the Strict-Transport-Security header with max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains to all HTTPS responses.
VULN.DESCRIPTION: The web application does not send an HSTS header, allowing downgrade attacks to plain HTTP on browsers that have not previously visited the site.
